family_A_collapsed.proof: F_R+lam(F_O-F_R) = (1-a)F+a*IN + lam*a(F-IN) = (1-a(1-lam))F + a(1-lam)IN  => 等价于 per-layer alpha a'=a(1-lam)

note: Family A（F_R+λ(F_O−F_R)）代数上等价于 per-layer α（α'=α(1−λ)），即已探索过的 M7 α-family -> 标记 EQUIVALENT，不消耗 GPU
